title: Proper perfect pushforward preserves compact objects
statement: Let $X,Y$ be Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] whose stalk maps have finite Tor dimension: for each $x$ there exists $n$ such that $Tor_i^{\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}}(\mathcal O_{X,x},N)=0$ for every module $N$ and $i>n$. Choose derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] for $X,Y$ with possibly different Hom universes and their universe-$u$ coproducts [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-direct-sums]. Let $R:D_{QCoh}(X)\to D_{QCoh}(Y)$ and an isomorphism $R\circ\iota_Y\cong\iota_X\circ Rf_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] be given. For every compact object $P$ [def-pc-compact-object], $R(P)$ is compact.

proof.text: Normalize both derived models, and the models on all their opens, using K-injective resolutions and localization equivalences. These equivalences identify derived direct images by their universal property and preserve compactness through their additive Hom equivalences and coproduct comparisons.

By the converse of Tag 09M1, a compact P is perfect: restrict to affines by adjunction with a coproduct-preserving direct image and apply the affine compact-object criterion. The finite Tor hypothesis is the stated stalkwise perfect-morphism criterion. Proper perfect direct image makes Rf_*P perfect; perfect-object compactness makes it compact on Y.

Transfer back to the given models. The given eR component identifies R(P) with Rf_*P after the fully faithful inclusions; lift this isomorphism to D_QCoh(Y). Precomposition by an isomorphism gives additive Hom equivalences commuting with the compactness comparison. Thus R(P) is compact.

proof_origin.note: Source argument with explicit localization transport to the arbitrary given derived models.

lean.statement:
theorem properPerfect_preserves_compact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hTor : ∀ x : X, ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) (i : ℕ), n < i →
        IsZero (((Tor (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))) i).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap x).hom).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)))).obj N))
    (R : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (eR : R ⋙ (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).ι ≅
      (schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) :
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) := derivedQCohDirectSums X
    let _ : HasCoproducts.{u} (schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) := derivedQCohDirectSums Y
    ∀ P : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, IsCompactObject P → IsCompactObject (R.obj P)
